Google Search Console (GSC) is a free web-based tool provided by Google that helps you understand how Google sees your website and local business.
It’s not a fancy marketing platform, but it’s absolutely critical for local SEO.
giving you insights into your website’s performance in search results.
It’s designed to help you identify and fix technical issues that might be preventing your business from ranking as high as it could.
It’s also a fantastic way to see what people are actually searching for when they’re looking for your type of business.
Google needs to trust that your information is accurate and up-to-date.

Search Console isn’t just about finding what people are searching for; it’s also about fixing any issues that might be preventing your business from ranking.
It’s like a detective, flagging potential problems and giving you the tools to resolve them.
Here are some common issues you might find: Incorrect Address: Double-check your address on your website and Google Business Profile.
Missing or Incorrect Phone Number: Make sure your phone number is accurate and prominently displayed.
Don’t just say “Serving the Tri-State Area” - be specific.
Map Pin Issues: Ensure your map pin is accurately placed and shows the correct location.
